gloss: to hit the mark; to strike the target

definitions.gloss: to hit the mark; to strike the target; to hit
definitions.explanation: For a projectile, shot, or thrown object to reach and hit its intended target. Used for physical targets such as in shooting, archery, or combat.

definitions.gloss: to guess correctly; to hit the nail on the head
definitions.explanation: For a prediction, guess, or assessment to turn out to be exactly right. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三本|さんぼん}とも{命中|めいちゅう}した。
examples.english: All three arrows hit the mark.

examples.japanese: ⟦ミサイル→ミサイル：26959_misairu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{命中|めいちゅう}した。
examples.english: The missile struck the target precisely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{命中|めいちゅう}した。
examples.english: My prediction was right on the mark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{核心|かくしん}→核心：13105_kakushin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{命中|めいちゅう}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Her observation hit right at the heart of the matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気予報|てんきよほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{命中|めいちゅう}して、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
examples.english: The weather forecast was spot on, and it really did start raining in the afternoon.

notes:
Composed of {命|めい} (life, fate, order) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (hit, middle). Originally a military and martial arts term that has extended into everyday figurative use. The ⟦{命中|めいちゅう}{率|りつ}→命中率：28243_meichuuritsu⟧ (hit rate, accuracy rate) is commonly used in gaming and statistics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{命中|めいちゅう}する: to hit the target
- ⟦{命中|めいちゅう}{率|りつ}→命中率：28243_meichuuritsu⟧: hit rate, accuracy
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{命中|めいちゅう}する: a prediction proves correct
- ⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{命中|めいちゅう}する: to hit accurately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to hit — everyday word; broader in meaning (lottery, guess, etc.)
- ⟦{的中|てきちゅう}する→的中する：15431_tekichuusuru⟧: to hit the mark — very similar; more commonly used for predictions and guesses
- ⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to hit (transitive) — casual; to aim and successfully hit something
